name: alien-agent-id
description: A portable cryptographic identity, encrypted credential vault, and logged-in browser for AI agents. The agent uses your API keys and logins by name without ever seeing them (vault unlocked automatically by its own local key), signs its git commits, and drives sites you're already logged into (e.g. Gmail). Works standalone; optionally link the identity to a verified human via Alien Network biometric SSO.

plugins.name: agent-id-core
plugins.description: Shared library for Alien Agent ID: crypto primitives, v3 bundle format, universal verifier, SignatureEngine, OIDC, state I/O. Required by every other agent-id-* plugin.

plugins.name: agent-id-git
plugins.description: SSH-signed git commits with Agent-ID trailers and v3 proof notes; verify provenance on any commit.

plugins.name: agent-id-vault
plugins.description: Portable encrypted credential vault with LUKS-style slots (passphrase + agent-key + phone/owner-approval) and typed/domain-scoped credential records.

plugins.name: agent-id-proxy
plugins.description: Local credential-injecting HTTP proxy. Agent calls http://<proxy>/<credname>/<upstream-host>/<path>; proxy materializes the credential by type, validates the host allowlist, and forwards over real HTTPS. Universal across services without TLS interception.

plugins.name: agent-id-auth
plugins.description: DPoP-signed calls to Alien-aware services: discovery, capabilities, one-shot signed requests.

plugins.name: agent-id-browser
plugins.description: Signs an agent into a website with a vault credential, in a browser reached over its RPC port. The password goes from the vault straight into the page; 2FA comes from a stored seed or a card to the owner.

plugins.name: agent-id-mcp
plugins.description: MCP server exposing agent-id identity, vault, and the vault-sealed browser as MCP tools — the connector shape Claude Cowork (and other MCP hosts) consume, where the CLI/hook/local-Chrome plugin model can't run. Thin adapter over the agent-id-* CLIs; runs stdio locally or Streamable-HTTP when hosted.
